@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+name: Backend security regression tests
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  backend-tests:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    defaults:
+      run:
+        working-directory: .
+    steps:
+      - name: Check out source
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - name: Node.js setup
+        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: '22'
+          cache: npm
+      - name: Install pinned dependencies
+        run: npm ci
+      - name: Run isolated old-JWT regression
+        run: node --test tests/oldAndroidJwtRegression.test.js
+      - name: Check authentication source syntax
+        run: node --check src/middleware/authMiddleware.js
